literal_meaning: চলা বা গতিবিধির প্রকাশ; সকল চলমানতা
example_sentences_in_bangla: চলাচলে তার মতো মানুষ খুব কম দেখা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: People like him are rare in the whole world.
Everyone is busy in this world.
history: Derived from the concept of 'charāchara' in Sanskrit, referring to all moving (chara) and stationary (achara) beings in the universe, rooted in ancient Indian philosophy.
note: The idiom 'চলাচল' appears to be a variant or possible transcription error for 'চরাচর', based on the provided synonym and meaning.
